sources.entry: fastapi - A modern, fast web framework for building APIs with standard Python type hints.

summary.one_liner: FastAPI is a high-performance Python web framework for building APIs using standard Python type hints, built on Starlette and Pydantic.
summary.what_it_does: Lets you declare path, query, body, header, cookie, form and file parameters as ordinary Python function parameters with type annotations, and handles validation, data conversion and error responses from those declarations. Generates OpenAPI schemas and serves two interactive documentation UIs (Swagger UI and ReDoc) automatically. Provides a dependency injection system, OAuth2/JWT and HTTP Basic security helpers, WebSockets, CORS, cookie sessions, and GraphQL integration with Strawberry and other libraries. The fastapi CLI runs a development server with auto-reload via Uvicorn, and the README describes an optional one-command deploy to FastAPI Cloud. Testing is described as working with HTTPX and pytest.
use_cases: Serving machine learning model predictions over HTTP
Validating JSON request bodies with Pydantic models
Generating OpenAPI docs and client code for an API
Adding OAuth2 or JWT authentication to a web API
Building WebSocket or async backend services
how_to_run: Install uv, then run: uv add "fastapi[standard]"
Create main.py with a FastAPI() app and route decorators
Run the development server: uv run fastapi dev
Open the browser at the local address to see the JSON response
Open the /docs path for Swagger UI or /redoc for ReDoc
Optionally deploy with: uv run fastapi deploy
notable: Uses standard Python type hints as the only declaration syntax, with validation and docs derived from them
Automatic interactive API docs via Swagger UI and ReDoc
Built on Starlette for web handling and Pydantic for data validation
Optional fastapi CLI for dev server and deployment commands
Companion projects named in README: Typer for CLIs
caveats: Optional extras such as orjson and ujson are needed for ORJSONResponse and UJSONResponse
The README says deployment to FastAPI Cloud is optional and other providers require their own guides
Performance claims are cited from TechEmpower benchmarks and internal estimates, not independently verified here
